description: This source file defines the AtMostOneOrleansConstructorAnalyzer class, which is a Roslyn analyzer ensuring that classes or structs in Orleans projects have at most one constructor marked for Orleans serialization.

classes.name: AtMostOneOrleansConstructorAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer for C# that enforces a rule allowing at most one Orleans-related constructor per class or struct.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Analyzes class or struct declarations to ensure they do not contain more than one Orleans serializer constructor, reporting a diagnostic if the rule is violated.
